title: Gifted-education advisor assigns ESP, crop circles and abduction stories

tellings.quote: I was consistently being assigned ESP. Eventually evolved into crop circles. She's like looking to abduction stories.

plain: Deep Prasad, a researcher, says that when he was at school a gifted-education advisor kept giving him strange topics: first ESP, the supposed ability to sense things without the normal senses, then crop circles, the large patterns found pressed into fields of crops, and finally stories of people abducted by aliens. He tells Michels it from his own childhood: "I was consistently being assigned ESP. Eventually evolved into crop circles. She's like looking to abduction stories."
